title: COMMITTED INTERACTION TIMING SHOWCASE
description: The release frames the feature as seasonal structure, while burying the real priority in the reward cadence. consequence: Every common action gained weight. Most of it landed on the player's patience. Marketing finally found footage that did not require a glossary.
